description: Get the current usage and entitlement snapshot for your workspace: subscription tier, when the billing period ends (currentPeriodEnd), free-minute pool balances (testing/loadTesting/mapping/s2s/s2stest/compliance), purchased-pack balances, current-period consumption, and remaining LLM-enrichment tokens. Takes no arguments: the workspace is always the API key's own. Use when: someone asks how many minutes are left, what tier they are on, or whether there is enough capacity before kicking off an expensive job. Figures are seconds and tokens, never money. Read-only.
name: getWorkspaceUsage

outputSchema.description:
MCP-agent-friendly subset of `BillingInfo`. Returned by
`GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/usage` on the api-key gateway
(Phase 76 — MCP-02 tool `getWorkspaceUsage`). Does NOT include
Stripe-internal fields, checkout URLs, or PII.

currentPeriodEnd.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the current billing period ends. Free-tier pools reset at this time.

loadTesting.description:
Per-pool usage snapshot. Free + purchased seconds remaining, plus
seconds consumed in the current billing period.

currentPeriodUsedSecs.description: Seconds consumed in the current period.

freeRemainingSecs.description: Free-tier seconds remaining for this period (resets at `currentPeriodEnd`).

purchasedRemainingSecs.description: Purchased-pack seconds remaining (carries over between periods).
